propositions: Contributors and subagents must fast-forward their own worktree after a Gerrit merge, never the shared main checkout, before closing a ticket.
The transition close completion precheck (_referencing_commit_exists) searches git log from HEAD to verify the merged rebar-ticket: commit is reachable, and will fail if HEAD lacks the commit.
Documentation guidance in AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md was missing explicit instruction to fast-forward the worktree post-merge and warn against touching the shared main checkout.
The fix is documentation-only: add post-merge fast-forward guidance to AGENTS.md close-discipline section and create new §2f subsection in CONTRIBUTING.md, with no code changes.
Both AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md must include the directive 'git fetch origin && git merge --ff-only origin/main' and warn never to fast-forward the shared main checkout.
